text: Binary per-row flag: 1 if at least one single other-user comment (parsed from the JSON list OC_comments) first explicitly states in words that the OP's view or a point of it is valid/correct/reasonable (partial agreement), and then, later in that same comment, introduces a narrower specific caveat, exception or qualification. title and argument are context only, used to identify the OP's target view. Both parts must be in one comment; separate comments don't combine. Bare politeness, a bare "but" without explicit acknowledgment, or a blanket rejection of the whole view don't count. Ignore OP text announcing a view change or delta award, post-outcome thank-yous/resolution updates, and text reporting the outcome; generic discussion of delta/platform rules stays eligible. Ignore comment text that merely quotes the OP as background. Output 0 if the list is valid but empty or no comment qualifies; null if OC_comments is missing or malformed, or title/argument is missing so the target can't be determined. List order carries no meaning.
